payload.body:
OpenERP becomes a Sentropic dev-app (managed lifecycle, like radar-immobilier) running as a pure OIDC Relying Party against the Sentropic IdP (@sentropic/auth-hono).

User decisions taken:
- Stateful DB-backed sessions (option 1B)
- Tenant model follows Sentropic (workspace at OauthClient level; tenantId is NOT a JWT claim)
- rpID/passkey ceremonies live at the Sentropic IdP (auth.sent-tech.ca); OpenERP runs no WebAuthn server
- OpenERP retains its own internal multi-tenancy (organizations + organization_members + organization_id session claim)

Scope of AUTH-39-A (subset of auth-hono, ~8 of 15 ports):
- DELETE passkey-service.ts, webauthn.ts handler, identity-provider.ts issuer parts
- ADD oidc-client.ts, openerp_session_port, openerp_user_port, cookie/token/account-policy ports
- ADD migration 0034 openerp_sessions (with organization_id extension) + 0035 oidc_state (PKCE/nonce)
- ADD handlers /auth/login, /auth/oauth/callback, /auth/logout, /auth/org-select
- Env: add OAUTH_ISSUER_URL/CLIENT_ID/CLIENT_SECRET/REDIRECT_URI; retire OPENERP_WEBAUTHN_* + OPENERP_WEB_ORIGIN
- jose downgrade ^6 -> ^5 (auth-hono peer dep)
- Org-picker: JSON 409 {code:ORGANIZATION_SELECTION_REQUIRED, organizations:[]}
- Hard guards: publicKey base64url decode, createRemoteJWKSet caching, state/nonce binding, PKCE S256

Awaiting:
- Opus peer-review (aadc37b621e0635e8) — adversarial fact-check of the plan
- Sentropic-team residual: tenantId on the openerp OauthClient row (set vs null)
- Sentropic-team action: register openerp OauthClient + k8s namespace + KUBE_CONFIG_DATA
payload.title: AUTH-39-A: adopt @sentropic/auth-hono as OIDC RP (Sentropic dev-app lifecycle)

payload.body: Define WebhookEgressPort interface plus a node-fetch adapter with timeout via AbortController, manual redirect refusal, and the four signing headers (X-OpenERP-Signature, X-OpenERP-Delivery-Id, X-OpenERP-Signed-At, X-OpenERP-Event-Type). SSRF guard is a constructor dependency (no-op in tests). New files: apps/api/src/webhook/webhook-egress-port.ts, apps/api/src/webhook/webhook-egress-fetch.ts, apps/api/test/foundation/webhook-egress-port.test.ts. DoD: 6 vitest cases (success, timeout, redirect refusal, network error, headers, in-memory port).
payload.title: W0-egress-port: outbound HTTP port + headers + redirect refusal

payload.body: Implement assertEgressAllowed(url, resolver) that refuses non-https, refuses ports other than 443, resolves DNS and blocks RFC1918, loopback, link-local, multicast, broadcast, IPv6 ULA + link-local. Wire into webhook-egress-fetch.ts via custom Node lookup so re-resolution before connect defends against DNS rebinding. New files: apps/api/src/webhook/webhook-ssrf-guard.ts, apps/api/test/foundation/webhook-ssrf-guard.test.ts. DoD: table tests for all blocked ranges + happy public IP.
payload.title: W0-ssrf-guard: DNS resolution + private IP block + rebinding defense

payload.body: attemptWebhookDelivery(db, ctx, deliveryId, port) loads delivery+endpoint with secret, POSTs through the port, then writes status, http_status, attempt_count, delivered_at, error_detail; mutates endpoint consecutive_failures (increment on fail, reset on success). No retry scheduling, no circuit-breaker disable yet. New files: apps/api/src/webhook/webhook-delivery-service.ts, apps/api/test/foundation/webhook-delivery-service.test.ts. Repo helpers added to webhook-endpoints.ts.
payload.title: W0-delivery-attempt: single-attempt egress service + counter mutations

payload.body: Pure module webhook-retry-policy.ts with nextRetryDelayMs(attempt) (30s, 2m, 10m, 1h, 6h with full jitter; cap 5 retries = 6 attempts) and classifyFailure(err, httpStatus) returning retryable|terminal. Wire into delivery service: retryable failures set next_retry_at, terminal stays failed. New file: apps/api/test/foundation/webhook-retry-policy.test.ts.
payload.title: W0-retry-backoff: exponential schedule + failure classification

payload.body: When consecutive_failures reaches 10, flip endpoint is_active=false, disabled_at=now(), emit audit webhook.webhook_endpoint.updated with disabledReason=circuit_breaker_opened. PATCH isActive=true via existing endpoint must also reset consecutive_failures=0 and disabled_at=null (re-arm). Deliveries targeting a disabled endpoint short-circuit to failed with error_detail=endpoint_disabled. New file: apps/api/test/foundation/webhook-circuit-breaker.test.ts.
payload.title: W0-circuit-breaker: auto-disable endpoint after N consecutive failures

payload.body: runDueWebhookDeliveries(db, ctx, asOf) selects pending_egress OR (failed AND next_retry_at<=now AND attempt_count<max) under for-update-skip-locked and calls attemptWebhookDelivery via the fetch port. Register worker handler webhook.delivery.tick in apps/worker. Add HTTP admin route POST /webhook/_admin/tick mirroring reporting pattern. New files: apps/worker/src/handlers/webhook.ts, apps/api/src/http/handlers/webhook-admin.ts, apps/worker/test/webhook-worker.test.ts, apps/api/test/foundation/webhook-admin-routes.test.ts. Update apps/worker/src/worker.ts + apps/api/src/http/routes/webhook.ts.
payload.title: W0-worker-tick: runDueWebhookDeliveries + admin tick route

payload.body: Extend makeWebhookEvaluator to enqueue a webhook.delivery.tick job after recording a delivery, so egress fires promptly instead of waiting for the periodic tick. Best-effort: enqueue failures are swallowed; record-only contract preserved. Extend apps/api/test/foundation/webhook-evaluator.test.ts.
payload.title: W0-evaluator-enqueue: kick the tick job from the evaluator (best-effort)

payload.body: Trade-off: piggyback on apps/worker = simpler ops but stuck HTTPS may starve other handlers; dedicated worker = isolation + parallelism, doubled deploy footprint. Recommended default: piggyback with strict 10s timeout. Decision needed before W0-worker-tick lands.
payload.title: Q1: decide worker topology (piggyback vs dedicated egress worker)

payload.body: Trade-off: per-endpoint config = customer power + complexity + amplification risk; global = fast and opaque. Recommended default: global constants (30s, 2m, 10m, 1h, 6h; 5 retries / 6 attempts). Decision needed before W0-retry-backoff lands.
payload.title: Q2: confirm backoff schedule constants

payload.body: Trade-off: manual re-arm = safe + noisy; auto re-arm with cooldown = self-healing but risks flapping. Recommended default: N=10 consecutive failures, manual re-arm only (admin PATCH). Decision needed before W0-circuit-breaker lands.
payload.title: Q3: circuit-breaker threshold + re-arm policy

payload.body: Trade-off: env flag bypass (risky) vs constructor-injected guard (clean). Recommended default: SSRF guard is a constructor dep of the fetch port; tests pass a no-op; production wires the real guard. No env-flag bypass.
payload.title: Q4: SSRF allowlist mechanism for tests

payload.body: Confirm consumer-facing header schema: X-OpenERP-Signature (v1=...), X-OpenERP-Delivery-Id (idempotency), X-OpenERP-Signed-At (unix seconds), X-OpenERP-Event-Type. Recommended default: ship as listed; document in consumer guide alongside W0-worker-tick.
payload.title: Q5: outbound delivery header contract

payload.body: Two reusable primitives. apps/api/src/foundation/tenant-enumeration.ts exports listActiveOrganizationIds(db) — RLS-bypass deliberate, justified in header. apps/worker/src/tick-scheduler.ts exports runTickLoop({ name, intervalMs, signal, runOnce, sleep?, onError? }) — never rethrows. Tests cover interval, abort, error swallowing. ~250 LOC. Depends-on: none.
payload.title: A0-1: tenant enumeration + tick scheduler primitive

payload.body: Wrap existing runDue* services. New apps/worker/src/ticks/{scheduled-delivery,recurring-billing,webhook-egress}.ts each export tickFor(db, tenant, asOf). Add @sentropic/openerp-api as workspace dep in apps/worker/package.json. applyScope/releaseScope per tenant. ~400 LOC. Depends-on: A0-1.
payload.title: A0-2: per-domain tick adapters (delivery + billing + webhook)

payload.body: apps/worker/src/main.ts spins up PgPoolHandle, launches per-domain runTickLoop in parallel, handles SIGTERM/SIGINT, drains in flight, closes pool. New apps/worker/bin/openerp-worker.mjs + package.json scripts.start. Integration test with fake pool asserts each domain ticks. ~350 LOC. Depends-on: A0-2.
payload.title: A0-3: openerp-worker entrypoint + graceful shutdown

payload.body: Migration 0036_workflow_schedules.sql adds cadence/timezone/next_run_at/last_run_at to workflow_definitions. runDueScheduledWorkflows(db, tenant, asOf) in workflow-service.ts mirrors runDueDeliveries. apps/worker/src/ticks/workflow.ts. Workflow triggered_by='schedule' enum extension. ~500 LOC. Depends-on: A0-3.
payload.title: A0-4: workflow cadence + runDueScheduledWorkflows service

payload.body: withTickInstrumentation({ domain, tenantId }) records processed/succeeded/failed/durationMs as JSON lines. Embedded HTTP listener /healthz (liveness) + /readyz (DB ping) on configurable port. apps/worker/src/observability.ts + health-server.ts. ~300 LOC. Depends-on: A0-3.
payload.title: A0-5: worker observability (logs, metrics, health endpoints)

payload.body: All 4 _admin/run|tick endpoints return 410 GONE when OPENERP_DISABLE_ADMIN_TICKS=true, emit deprecation audit_event otherwise. docs/ops/automation-runtime.md updated. Smoke tests cover both modes. ~250 LOC. Depends-on: A0-3.
payload.title: A0-6: deprecate HTTP _admin/tick endpoints behind feature flag

payload.body: Trade-off: jobs table = durability + per-job retry + audit but doubles latency. Direct call = simpler, already idempotent. Recommended default: direct call for v1; defer queue-driven to AUTOMATION-RUNTIME-V2.
payload.title: Q1: jobs-table dispatch vs direct call

payload.body: Trade-off: serial = predictable PG load, simple ordering. Parallel (p-limit 4) = better throughput. Recommended default: serial at MVP; expose OPENERP_WORKER_TENANT_CONCURRENCY env (default 1).
payload.title: Q2: per-tenant parallelism strategy

payload.body: Trade-off: SKIP LOCKED prevents double-processing per row but workers waste poll cycles. PG advisory lock per domain = single active worker. Recommended default: no leader election at MVP; add later if double-deploys appear.
payload.title: Q3: leader election for HA worker deploys

payload.body: Trade-off: reuse existing recordAuditEvent hook keeps action-execution converged. New triggered_by='schedule' path keeps schedule-cadence semantics independent. Recommended default: new path; extend workflow_runs.triggered_by check constraint.
payload.title: Q4: workflow schedule trigger path

payload.body: Trade-off: hard-cut breaks tenants driving from external cron. Soft-flag leaves footgun. Recommended default: soft-flag (OPENERP_DISABLE_ADMIN_TICKS, default false) with deprecation audit each invoc; hard-cut in v3.
payload.title: Q5: HTTP _admin/tick deprecation timeline
